scope: Hoover Tower exterior, eight pinned OSM parts; bounded primary-source photograph comparison, not a floor or elevation survey.

sourceGeometry.renderOnly: Overlapping parts are stacked at their exposed architectural levels. Every part retains its mapped maximum height; tower tip remains 87 m.

references.observation: Smooth shaft, three recessed panels per visible face, paired arch windows below octagonal crown, red dome and pale lantern.
Open crown arches, outward-bowed protective iron grilles, fluted piers and a relief crest. Unmeasured carving simplified to a small boss.
Stacked tower massing, lower wings and sparse shaft. Photo is dated 2011; not a current full-elevation survey.
Front portal, projecting entrance mass, small tiled polygonal cap, horizontal bands and small upper-level wing windows.
Stepped plaster parapet and shallow relief; inspected but exact ornament not reconstructed.

materialEvidence.finding: Stanford identifies pigmented cement stucco and a deliberately plain shaft, not exposed ashlar masonry; observation deck and carillon are on the 14th floor.

estimated: Window dimensions, vertical positions and mirrored treatment on unphotographed elevations
Wall thickness, relief depth, grille bar spacing and bowed cage depth
Colors under neutral renderer lighting; photographs have varying sun and exposure
Crown interior surface shading; no exact carillon or interior layout is asserted
Entrance door subdivision and lower-wing window spacing
Dome profile between mapped eave perimeter and mapped top height
notModeled: Interior floors, rooms, stairs, lift or bell arrangement without an inspected current floor plan

assetPolicy: Reference photographs are kept only in ignored local evidence. No photograph or copyrighted floor-plan PDF is redistributed in the app.
